paper_id: Backdoor Pre-trained Models Can Transfer to All
title: Backdoor Pre-trained Models Can Transfer to All
motivation: 开放预训练模型被广泛下载使用，用户无法判断其是否被植入后门；现有后门攻击依赖目标标签，无法适应下游任务标签空间变化
problem_framing: 能否在预训练阶段植入后门而不绑定特定目标标签，同时保持后门在各下游任务中的可迁移性？
key_insight: 将trigger映射到预训练模型目标token的输出表征(POR)而非标签，使后门随下游任务复用该表征而自动转移
method_signature: 伪孪生网络训练：冻结参考模型参数，指导目标模型在中毒文本上逼近POR同时保持其他表征正常
evaluation_criteria: 提出新指标Effectiveness(E)、Stealthiness(S)、Capability(C)替代CV领域的ASR，因NLP中trigger可重复插入且文本长度变化大
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: some triggers have inconsistent performance between the two datasets which is opposite to the result in sophisticated word
evidence_for_taste: the basic requirement for a successful backdoor model
the same trigger has a certain consistency on the performance across the two datasets
should not be considered as a good trigger since it is too long
thinking_moves: 将问题从label空间重新formulate到representation空间，绕过下游任务标签未知的限制
从CV领域metrics的不适用性反推NLP需新评估体系
借鉴定义良好的数学对象（如书名、人名）验证trigger有效性假设
通过attention score分析揭示trigger成功背后的机制
